datasets.name: quality_overview
datasets.displayName: Resumen de Calidad Bronze vs Silver
queryLines:
WITH bronze AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS unique_orders,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS duplicates
  FROM
    workspace.ecommerce_bronze.raw_sales_analytics
),
silver AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS unique_orders,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS duplicates
  FROM
    workspace.ecommerce_silver.cleansed_sales
)
SELECT
  b.total_rows AS bronze_total,
  s.total_rows AS silver_total,
  b.total_rows - s.total_rows AS rows_removed,
  b.duplicates AS bronze_duplicates,
  s.duplicates AS silver_duplicates,
  ROUND(b.duplicates * 100.0 / b.total_rows, 2) AS duplicate_pct,
  ROUND((b.total_rows - s.total_rows) * 100.0 / b.total_rows, 2) AS removed_pct,
  ROUND(s.total_rows * 100.0 / b.total_rows, 2) AS retention_pct
FROM
  bronze b CROSS JOIN silver s

queryLines:
WITH bronze_errors AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          order_id IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(order_id) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(order_id AS INT) IS NULL
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS type_order_id,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          customer_id IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(customer_id) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(customer_id AS INT) IS NULL
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS type_customer_id,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          quantity IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(quantity) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(quantity AS INT) IS NULL
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS type_quantity,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          unit_price IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(unit_price) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) IS NULL
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS type_unit_price,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          discount IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(discount) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(discount AS DECIMAL(5, 2)) IS NULL
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS type_discount,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          delivery_days IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(delivery_days) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(delivery_days AS INT) IS NULL
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS type_delivery_days,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          customer_rating IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(customer_rating) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(customer_rating AS DOUBLE) IS NULL
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS type_customer_rating,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          revenue IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(revenue) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(revenue AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) IS NULL
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS type_revenue,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          order_date IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(order_date) != ''
          AND NOT rlike(TRIM(order_date), '^[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4}$')
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS date_format,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          quantity IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(quantity) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(quantity AS INT) IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(quantity AS INT) <= 0
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS range_quantity,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          revenue IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(revenue) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(revenue AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(revenue AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) < 0
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS range_revenue,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          customer_rating IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(customer_rating) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(customer_rating AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            CAST(customer_rating AS DOUBLE) < 1
            OR CAST(customer_rating AS DOUBLE) > 5
          )
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS range_rating,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          discount IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(discount) != ''
          AND TRY_CAST(discount AS DECIMAL(5, 2)) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            CAST(discount AS DECIMAL(5, 2)) < 0
            OR CAST(discount AS DECIMAL(5, 2)) > 1
          )
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS range_discount,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          product_category IS NOT NULL
          AND product_category != TRIM(product_category)
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS space_category,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          region IS NOT NULL
          AND region != TRIM(region)
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS space_region,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          payment_method IS NOT NULL
          AND payment_method != TRIM(payment_method)
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS space_payment,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          order_id IS NULL
          OR TRIM(order_id) = ''
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS null_order_id,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          customer_id IS NULL
          OR TRIM(customer_id) = ''
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS null_customer_id,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          revenue IS NULL
          OR TRIM(revenue) = ''
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS null_revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS unique_order_ids
  FROM
    workspace.ecommerce_bronze.raw_sales_analytics
)
SELECT
  error_type,
  error_detail,
  error_count,
  correction_applied
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      stack(
        19,
        'Tipo de Dato',
        'order_id no casteable a INT',
        type_order_id,
        'CAST(INT)',
        'Tipo de Dato',
        'customer_id no casteable a INT',
        type_customer_id,
        'CAST(INT)',
        'Tipo de Dato',
        'quantity no casteable a INT',
        type_quantity,
        'CAST(INT) + CHECK > 0',
        'Tipo de Dato',
        'unit_price no casteable a DECIMAL',
        type_unit_price,
        'CAST(DECIMAL(10,2))',
        'Tipo de Dato',
        'discount no casteable a DECIMAL',
        type_discount,
        'CAST(DECIMAL(5,2))',
        'Tipo de Dato',
        'delivery_days no casteable a INT',
        type_delivery_days,
        'CAST(INT)',
        'Tipo de Dato',
        'customer_rating no casteable a DOUBLE',
        type_customer_rating,
        'CAST(DOUBLE)',
        'Tipo de Dato',
        'revenue no casteable a DECIMAL',
        type_revenue,
        'CAST(DECIMAL(10,2)) + CHECK >= 0',
        'Formato de Fecha',
        'order_date no cumple M/d/yyyy',
        date_format,
        'TO_DATE(M/d/yyyy)',
        'Violacion de Rango',
        'quantity <= 0',
        range_quantity,
        'CHECK > 0',
        'Violacion de Rango',
        'revenue < 0',
        range_revenue,
        'CHECK >= 0',
        'Violacion de Rango',
        'rating fuera de 1-5',
        range_rating,
        'Validacion de rango',
        'Violacion de Rango',
        'discount fuera de 0-1',
        range_discount,
        'Validacion de rango',
        'Espacios en Blanco',
        'product_category con espacios',
        space_category,
        'TRIM',
        'Espacios en Blanco',
        'region con espacios',
        space_region,
        'TRIM',
        'Espacios en Blanco',
        'payment_method con espacios',
        space_payment,
        'TRIM',
        'Valores Nulos',
        'order_id NULL o vacio',
        null_order_id,
        'Filtro NOT NULL',
        'Valores Nulos',
        'customer_id NULL o vacio',
        null_customer_id,
        'Sin correccion (permite NULL)',
        'Duplicados',
        'order_id duplicados',
        total_rows - unique_order_ids,
        'SELECT DISTINCT'
      ) AS (error_type, error_detail, error_count, correction_applied)
    FROM
      bronze_errors
  )
ORDER BY
  error_count DESC

datasets.name: gold_reconciliation
queryLines:
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM
      workspace.ecommerce_silver.cleansed_sales
  ) AS silver_records,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM
      workspace.ecommerce_gold.fact_sales
  ) AS gold_records,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2)
    FROM
      workspace.ecommerce_silver.cleansed_sales
  ) AS silver_revenue,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2)
    FROM
      workspace.ecommerce_gold.fact_sales
  ) AS gold_revenue,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM
      workspace.ecommerce_silver.cleansed_sales
  )
    - (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM
        workspace.ecommerce_gold.fact_sales
    ) AS record_diff,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2)
    FROM
      workspace.ecommerce_silver.cleansed_sales
  )
    - (
      SELECT
        ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2)
      FROM
        workspace.ecommerce_gold.fact_sales
    ) AS revenue_diff

lines:
## 📊 Calidad de Datos E-commerce — Bronze, Silver y Gold

### Arquitectura Completa: Limpieza, Integridad, Agregaciones y Star Schema

Este dashboard cubre las tres capas del pipeline de datos e-commerce:

- **Bronze** — Datos crudos, todo STRING, sin constraints
- **Silver** — Datos limpios, tipados y validados (CAST, TRIM, CHECK, NOT NULL)
- **Gold** — Star schema optimizado para BI (`fact_sales` + `dim_date` + `dim_products`)

La reconciliación Silver vs Gold confirma **zero-loss**: la capa Gold preserva todos los registros y el revenue total.
